items.prompt: Find the area of an equilateral triangle of side 12 cm, in sq cm.
items.solution: 1. Height of an equilateral triangle = s*sqrt(3)/2 = 12*sqrt(3)/2 = 6*sqrt(3). 2. Area = (1/2)*base*height = (1/2)*12*6*sqrt(3). 3. = 36*sqrt(3). Answer A.

items.prompt: An isosceles triangle has equal sides 13 cm each and base 10 cm. Find its area in sq cm.
items.solution: 1. The altitude bisects the base: half-base = 5. 2. Height = sqrt(13^2-5^2) = sqrt(169-25) = sqrt(144) = 12. 3. Area = 10*12/2 = 60. Answer B.
